label: Justyn-style reel
about: The viral 'I didn't edit this' look: serif hook title behind you, brand-pill captions with italic-serif pops, proof inserts, CTA end card.
editor_notes: Hook title = the bold claim in 2-4 words. Add proof inserts (pip of raw footage / screenshots, timer card, prompt box, chat bubbles) where the script mentions them. End on the CTA card with the brand's comment-to-DM line.
